svg.title: "Hey Jarvis, play faint" in the bedroom - one command end to end (2026-11-19)

g.text: "Hey Jarvis, play faint" in the bedroom - one command end to end (2026-11-19)
the other satellite heard it too:
wake word: pause this room's music
bedroom: note whether white noise is on
voice_tone: a tone on the Pi if you spoke 2-12s
[white noise is on in the bedroom]
(text only: no bedroom replies under white noise)
"faint is not in your liked songs"
clear the flag, no spoken reply:
[white noise on, bridge offline or replies switched off]
[a reply to speak ("Couldn't play ...", "... not in your liked songs")]
VLC plays it on the jack,
resume the music paused at the wake word
every night 04:30 (systemd --user timer, only if the library changed)
sync_spotify_songs.sh: spotify_library.py reads liked songs + playlists,
stt-fallback re-reads the song list by itself
